key: We're sorry; admittance to the apartments is for tenants only.
en: We're sorry; admittance to the apartments is for tenants only.
ja: 申し訳ございませんが、このアパートへの立ち入りは入居者様限定となっております。

key: Did you know?
en: Did you know?
ja: 知ってました?

key: Inkay are creatures so strange that even the way they evolve is bizarre!
en: Inkay are creatures so strange that even the way they evolve is bizarre!
ja: マーイーカは、進化の仕方まで奇妙な、実に不思議な生き物なんです!

key: Normally you have to make sure they're upside down when it comes to...
en: Normally you have to make sure they're upside down when it comes to...
ja: 普通は、進化させる時に逆さまにしておかないといけないんですが……

key: But around here, if you startle one while it has the chance to evolve, it will actually go through with it!
en: But around here, if you startle one while it has the chance to evolve, it will actually go through with it!
ja: でも、この辺りでは、進化できるタイミングで驚かせると、実際に進化してしまうんです!

key: Hey, hey, see this Skitty? It fell from a long ways up...
en: Hey, hey, see this Skitty? It fell from a long ways up...
ja: ねえねえ、このエネコ見て? すごく高いところから落ちてきたの……

key: It was really badly hurt, but I can fix it! I know I can!
en: It was really badly hurt, but I can fix it! I know I can!
ja: すごく怪我してたけど、僕なら治せる! きっとできる!

key: It's okay Skitty, I'll keep you.
en: It's okay Skitty, I'll keep you.
ja: 大丈夫だよエネコ、僕が飼うから。

key: When I grow up, I wanna help heal even more hurt Pokémon!
en: When I grow up, I wanna help heal even more hurt Pokémon!
ja: 大きくなったら、もっとたくさんの怪我したポケモンを治してあげたい!

key: Then it's settled-- I'll become a Nurse Joy!
en: Then it's settled-- I'll become a Nurse Joy!
ja: それじゃ決まりだ――僕、ジョーイさんになる!

key: SKITTY: ...Skiiiiii...
en: SKITTY: ...Skiiiiii...
ja: エネコ: ……ニャー……

key: SKITTY: Ski-tty!
en: SKITTY: Ski-tty!
ja: エネコ: ニャニャー!

key: GRANDMA: My grandson is stuck on the idea of healing Skitty himself.
en: GRANDMA: My grandson is stuck on the idea of healing Skitty himself.
ja: おばあさん: うちの孫ったら、自分でエネコを治すって聞かなくてね。

key: If we only took it to a Center it would be just fine, but he's so stubborn.
en: If we only took it to a Center it would be just fine, but he's so stubborn.
ja: センターに連れて行けばすぐ済むのに、頑固で困ったものだよ。

key: If we could give him an Oran Berry or something, that might even be enough...
en: If we could give him an Oran Berry or something, that might even be enough...
ja: オボンのみか何かあげれば、それで十分かもしれないんだけどねえ……

key: Say, is that an Oran Berry you've got there?
en: Say, is that an Oran Berry you've got there?
ja: ねえ、それ、オボンのみかい?

key: Would you be willing to spare it for a poor boy's sentiments?
en: Would you be willing to spare it for a poor boy's sentiments?
ja: かわいそうな坊やの気持ちのために、譲ってもらえないかね?

key: GRANDMA: Oh, thank you, generous Trainer.
en: GRANDMA: Oh, thank you, generous Trainer.
ja: おばあさん: ああ、ありがとう、優しいトレーナーさんだね。

key: \PN handed over the Oran Berry.
en: \PN handed over the Oran Berry.
ja: \PNはオボンのみを渡した。

key: GRANDMA: All right, if you want to heal Skitty yourself, try using this.
en: GRANDMA: All right, if you want to heal Skitty yourself, try using this.
ja: おばあさん: さあ、自分でエネコを治したいなら、これを使ってごらん。

key: BOY: This?
en: BOY: This?
ja: 男の子: これ?

key: Okay.
en: Okay.
ja: うん。

key: BOY used the Oran Berry! Skitty recovered HP!
en: BOY used the Oran Berry! Skitty recovered HP!
ja: 男の子はオボンのみを使った! エネコのHPが回復した!

key: SKITTY: Ski-ski-ski-Skitty!
en: SKITTY: Ski-ski-ski-Skitty!
ja: エネコ: ニャニャニャニャー!

key: GRANDMA: There you go. It's all better, and thanks to you!
en: GRANDMA: There you go. It's all better, and thanks to you!
ja: おばあさん: ほら、すっかり良くなったよ。あなたのおかげだねえ!

key: BOY: Yay!
en: BOY: Yay!
ja: 男の子: やったー!

key: GRANDMA: But I think it's best we let Skitty go now.
en: GRANDMA: But I think it's best we let Skitty go now.
ja: おばあさん: でも、そろそろエネコを自由にしてあげるのが一番だと思うんだよ。

key: Raising a Pokémon is a lot of responsibility, and it may be a bit early for you yet.
en: Raising a Pokémon is a lot of responsibility, and it may be a bit early for you yet.
ja: ポケモンを育てるのは大きな責任が伴うことだし、あなたにはまだ少し早いかもしれないね。

key: BOY: No, grandma! I can do it!
en: BOY: No, grandma! I can do it!
ja: 男の子: いやだよ、おばあちゃん! 僕にできるもん!

key: GRANDMA: Taking care of other living things means putting their needs before your own.
en: GRANDMA: Taking care of other living things means putting their needs before your own.
ja: おばあさん: 他の命の世話をするというのは、自分より相手の必要を優先するということだよ。

key: It was okay this time, but in the future you really must take injured Pokémon into a Center for care regardless of your personal desires.
en: It was okay this time, but in the future you really must take injured Pokémon into a Center for care regardless of your personal desires.
ja: 今回はたまたま大丈夫だったけど、これからは自分の気持ちがどうであれ、怪我をしたポケモンはちゃんとセンターに連れて行かなきゃいけないよ。

key: BOY: Okay, maybe you're right...
en: BOY: Okay, maybe you're right...
ja: 男の子: うん、そうかもしれない……

key: But if we let Skitty go wild, it could get hurt again!
en: But if we let Skitty go wild, it could get hurt again!
ja: でも、エネコを野生に戻したら、また怪我しちゃうかもしれないよ!

key: GRANDMA: Oh, for heaven's sake...
en: GRANDMA: Oh, for heaven's sake...
ja: おばあさん: ああ、まったくもう……

key: Tell me, Trainer, would you be able to adopt this Skitty, and keep it out of trouble for my boy?
en: Tell me, Trainer, would you be able to adopt this Skitty, and keep it out of trouble for my boy?
ja: トレーナーさん、このエネコを引き取って、うちの孫のためにも、トラブルに巻き込まれないようにしてもらえないかい?

key: GRANDMA: Bless you, Trainer.
en: GRANDMA: Bless you, Trainer.
ja: おばあさん: ありがとうね、トレーナーさん。

key: BOY: You'd better take good care of it!
en: BOY: You'd better take good care of it!
ja: 男の子: ちゃんと大事にしてよね!

key: GRANDMA: What he means to say is, thank you very much.
en: GRANDMA: What he means to say is, thank you very much.
ja: おばあさん: この子が言いたいのは、本当にありがとうっていうことだよ。

key: Oh, that's too bad. Hm...
en: Oh, that's too bad. Hm...
ja: あら、それは残念だねえ。うーん……

key: Oh, no worries. I understand. Hm...
en: Oh, no worries. I understand. Hm...
ja: ああ、気にしないで。分かるよ。うーん……

key: I don't suppose you changed your mind about that Skitty?
en: I don't suppose you changed your mind about that Skitty?
ja: あのエネコのこと、気が変わったりはしてないかい?

key: So much nicer without that Skitty meowing every night...
en: So much nicer without that Skitty meowing every night...
ja: あのエネコが毎晩鳴かなくなって、ずいぶん静かになったよ……

key: This is a pretty nice complex, except for the group of thugs that hangs out back.
en: This is a pretty nice complex, except for the group of thugs that hangs out back.
ja: 裏でたむろしてるならず者集団を除けば、なかなかいいマンションだよ。

key: It's nice to be back to peace and quiet, but goodness, if I haven't been busy with the restoration!
en: It's nice to be back to peace and quiet, but goodness, if I haven't been busy with the restoration!
ja: 平和で静かな暮らしに戻れたのはうれしいけど、いやはや、復興作業でずっと忙しかったよ!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
